scope: Actual 22-page PPTX render, all 47 source-generated click checkpoints, and detailed inspection of mathematical notation and gradient arrows.

findings.message: Initial Roofline labels overlapped the axes and ridge panel; moved the traffic and AI examples to a separate readout column, separated the axis label and ticks, and inspected new renders.
Initial weight-gradient arrows crossed the superscript formulas; moved the computational nodes down and terminated arrows below formula labels, then inspected the final native slide and checkpoints.
Initial Router annotations approached the footer and overlapped source text frames; raised them and separated the columns, then inspected the final page.
Matrix highlight layers intentionally cover and repeat the same cell text; formula superscripts are separate font-fallback glyph spans. These are not unintended collisions.
Live Microsoft PowerPoint slideshow playback was unavailable. Native OOXML timeline references and an independent LibreOffice import were checked; 83 click groups are retained.
